name: Hybrid Sphere Tracing and Ray Tracing
aliases: Hybrid Ray Tracing and Sphere Tracing
definition: A rendering technique that uses ray tracing for primitives that support closed-form ray intersections or BVH traversal, and falls back to sphere tracing for sub-expressions that do not have a ray form (e.g., smooth blends, offsets).
summary: Hybrid Sphere Tracing and Ray Tracing accelerates rendering by using exact ray tracing for standard primitives and sphere tracing for procedural shapes, combining speed with SDF flexibility.
